stem: Which sentence shows how the brothers feel when their father explains what they really saw in the hallway?

options.label: F
options.text: The brothers tried to get through the doorway at the same time and ended up in a tangled heap on the floor.

options.label: G
options.text: Nathan and Alex started talking at the same time.

options.label: H
options.text: It was bad enough to have an older brother who sometimes made fun of him.

options.label: J
options.text: Nathan’s mouth formed a grin, and then Alex started to laugh.
